extraction: Explicitly selected recognition classes and own training scripts; new repository history. No app history, old model, app services or song fixtures.

NativeOcrWire.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition: bounded authenticated raster/evidence transport, exact round-trip synthetic tests and buffered gzip to avoid per-pixel compressor calls. No credentials, paths or private evidence included.

NativeOcrServer.java.notes: Optional loopback-only service with parent-stdin lifetime, source and credential checks, three bounded workers and checksum-verified models. Android and Hub lifecycle adapters are excluded.

NativeOcrRoundTrip.java.notes: Optional acceptance harness uses a supplied synthetic image and ephemeral credential. Checks exact local/remote evidence, three clients, rejected identity and parent shutdown. No input images bundled.

OnnxOcrInference.java.notes: Optional ONNX binding only, outside the JDK-only default source set. Verifies model/dictionary hashes before sessions, reads explicit UTF-8 dictionary, bounds CPU threads, closes sessions/results/tensors. Same reviewed binding used by Android instrumentation and desktop evaluation; no runtime or model binaries copied.

PortableOcrProbe.java.notes: Optional ImageIO desktop evaluation entry point; user-supplied image only. No bundled fixtures or machine paths. Package/license header adapted.

PortableOcr.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition. Platform-independent half-pixel BGR preprocessing, bounded probability components, conservative stacked-row splitting and CTC alignment estimates. Caller supplies inference and dictionary; no runtime or weights bundled or enabled by default. Synthetic geometry/input/cancellation tests only; private score evidence excluded. Symbol boxes are alignment estimates, not measured ink. Existing three unrelated source drifts remain visible.

OcrText.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition: immutable platform-neutral OCR evidence preserving text, ordering, duplicate tokens, missing boxes and symbol geometry. Package/license header adapted. Android ML Kit copying adapter and bitmap consumers remain app-specific; synthetic immutable-evidence regressions included. No OCR engine/model replacement enabled.

OcrCtcDecoder.java.notes: Shared greedy CTC decoding accepts only one-part-per-million endpoint roundoff and clamps reported confidence; invalid probabilities remain rejected. Synthetic endpoint regression included. Android lazy ownership, fail-closed page memoization and separate cache generation remain app adapters. No external weights or private fixtures bundled.

NativeDecoderWire.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition on this base. Bounded authenticated transport for exact geometry and analysis records; package and license header adapted. Synthetic round-trip and rejection regressions only.

NativeDecoderStages.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition on this base. Extracts the existing geometry and header-normalization sequence without changing recognition thresholds or model weights.

NativeDecoderServer.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition and response-lifetime fix on this base. Loopback-only service with three processing threads, three bounded waiting slots, credential and source checks, and parent-stdin lifetime. Waits for client EOF after replies with bounded socket timeout; synthetic tests cover both operations. Standalone build generates its own fingerprint; no private fixtures, app services or runtime configuration copied.

ColumnInkBounds.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition on this base. Exact prefix/suffix ink bounds replace repeated raster scans in the Android dynamic-glyph splitter. Synthetic all-split equivalence regression included; platform bitmap adapter remains app-specific.

MeterCropRaster.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition on this base. Optional Android-independent ARGB meter cleanup, preserving per-pixel thresholds and mutation order. Bulk bitmap integration and dynamic glyph match memoization are Android-specific; no OCR variants or detector thresholds removed.

ExactRasterMemo.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree addition on this base; bounded exact-raster memoization for caller-provided OCR adapters. Android TextRecognizer session and bitmap bulk-read integration remain platform-specific. No detector thresholds or model weights changed.

MeterChangeDetector.java.notes: Whole-note-denominator OCR filter rejects contradictory 1/1 or 2/1 only with two complete written bars. Existing helper alignment reviewed. Android OCR calls this shared filter; explicit standalone annotations remain authoritative. Original synthetic tests. Uses Collectors.toList for Android API 26 compatibility.

OmrMeasurePostProcessor.java.notes: Raw barline validation rejects oscillating arpeggios and preserves straight thick and faint bars. Original synthetic geometry tests; no model or dependency changes.

OmrScoreInterpreter.java.notes: Scoped finiteBeamOverRule repair tolerates a bounded articulation followed by a fresh uninterrupted thin witness, not a long thick tail. Original synthetic tests. Prior stemBeforePaperTail repair retained. Unrelated pre-existing app decoder drift remains visible; source_sha256 intentionally unchanged, not whole-file parity.

ScoreTempoChange.java.notes: Reviewed pulse-unit repair: eighth and dotted-eighth glyphs retain exact fractional quarter BPM and the printed pulse length. Standalone API retains the three-argument tempo constructor. Android binary cache generation 252, viewer propagation, and selected-tempo integration remain platform adapters. No score images or private logs included.

TempoChangeDetector.java.notes: Reviewed opening-tempo OCR anchor fallback: an out-of-bounds annotation start may resolve only to the opening measure when its original verified digits independently belong there. Existing equals-ink, vertical staff exclusion and printed pulse-unit checks remain unchanged. Positive and later-row negative synthetic regressions included. Prior pulse-unit/fractional quarter-BPM behavior retained. No private evidence included.

PrintedMeasureRhythmGuard.java.notes: Preserve independently barred duet staves despite intervening whitespace using aligned continuous ink within two detected five-line staves. Original synthetic regression.

MeterOcrEvidence.java.notes: Reviewed working-tree OCR optimization on this base. Three agreeing meter renderings can terminate remaining scale probes without weakening the existing two-vote final consensus or accepting conflicting readings. Android crop generation, ML Kit scheduling and page-level fallback suppression remain app-specific. Synthetic public regression included.

ScoreTempoSelection.java.notes: Reviewed pulse-unit repair: eighth and dotted-eighth glyphs retain exact fractional quarter BPM and the printed pulse length. Standalone API retains the three-argument tempo constructor. Android binary cache generation 252, viewer propagation, and selected-tempo integration remain platform adapters. No score images or private logs included.

ocr_adapter_review.boundary: Android ML Kit, Bitmap cleanup and raster reflow remain app adapters. Standalone callers can obtain bounded signature crops and following measure indices, apply the shared ink threshold, submit horizontally reflowed crop OCR to MeterOcrEvidence, and pass accepted readings through Annotations.meters. The standalone package does not bundle an OCR engine.

piano_notation_review.boundary: Shared folio rejection, compact double-sharp recognition, and octave-clef numeral topology. Standalone Main and app playback both map the double-sharp token to two semitones. Android guide-cache format validation and version invalidation stay app-only. No source scores, phone logs, or private fixtures are distributed; new regressions use original generated geometry. Models and weights unchanged.

tablature_adapter_review.boundary: Android ML Kit OCR remains an app adapter, now includes rhythm lanes. Shared TabNotation decodes explicit duration/rest words and external stems/beams; TabEffect carries numeric effect curves through existing articulation serialization. App OrnamentPerformance applies the shared pitch curve to sampled playback; standalone JSON exposes guitarEffect and MIDI export isolates bend channels. No model weights, private fixtures or external source code imported. Unsupported graphical bend curves, tab ties, tuplets and ambiguous half-note stems remain limitations; missing rhythm remains estimated.

study_notation_review.boundary: Original raster geometry for stopped-note plus fourth-touch artificial harmonics, with conservative diamond and stem evidence. App OmrMeasureAnalyzer and standalone SheetInterpreter invoke the same helper after octave marks. Flat signature recovery accepts ordered spine runs and does not trim a verified clef header as a barline. Only these OmrScoreInterpreter hunks were ported; its previously reported unrelated app drift remains visible. New tests use original generated glyphs. No score scans, library content, logs, model weights or external code are included.

study_rhythm_review.boundary: Original generated regressions cover fused beam tips, staff-rule fringe, equal repeated implicit triplets, partial flat signatures and bare octave numerals with dotted spans. Shared helpers ported to the app; guide cache invalidation remains Android-only. OmrScoreInterpreter prior unrelated drift is retained, not hidden by a hash update. No score images, logs, private library or model weights included. These repairs are not a claim of complete score accuracy.

natural_fringe_review.boundary: Shared natural-glyph endpoint check permits only one extra fringe pixel beyond the usual spine tolerance when both endpoints have strong natural offsets. Existing asymmetric sharp regression retained; new original synthetic natural and sharp shapes added. Other OmrScoreInterpreter drift remains visible. No private score or model changes.

beam_and_header_review.boundary: Original raw-ink evidence preserves separate beam groups beneath fingering numerals while honoring explicit brackets. Complete clefs outrank later joined accidental masks, with damaged-clef fallback retained; dense header lookback and regular flat spacing exclude adjacent meter strokes. New synthetic regressions cover beam direction, brackets, dense keys, faded clefs and genuine key changes. Only reviewed shared changes carried over; the three pre-existing app drifts remain visible. No private scores, annotations, phone logs, model weights or external source code included.

broken_flat_shaft_review.boundary: Source-ink recovery requires an existing flat family, a substantial vertical shaft and a verified lower-right bowl. Small scan gaps may connect shaft pieces; isolated staff-rule pixels cannot start a recovered shaft. Original semantic spine count remains a lower bound. Synthetic broken-shaft and absent-bowl regressions preserve prior SplitFlatSpineTest coverage. Only this shared OmrScoreInterpreter change was ported; prior unrelated drift remains visible. No model or private fixture changes.

signature_boundary_spacing_review.boundary: Require adjacent vertical strokes for a double bar, excluding distant accidental shafts. A lone key symbol without a clef must follow its boundary locally; distant clef fragments cannot become key changes. Six original synthetic tests cover source-only bars, separated shafts, and nearby versus distant single-flat changes. Shared decoder change only. No model, private score, or phone-data changes. The three pre-existing unrelated mapped drifts remain visible.

imported_tab_layout_review.boundary: Shared six-rule geometry now checks multiple grayscale thresholds, wider string spacing, pale vertical barlines, and excludes partial tab rows from standard-staff pairing. Dark notation retains strict rule-length agreement; pale interrupted rules additionally require enclosing bars. Nine original synthetic tests cover faint, dashed, enlarged and negative standard-notation cases. No weights, OCR engine or tuning changes; no private fixtures included. Geometry validation is not full fret or timing accuracy.

damaged_study_notation_review.boundary: Global printed-ink recovery for fragmented clefs and key symbols, partial repeated sharp signatures, ledger-attached octave numerals, fingerings opposite a longer continuous beam, and tuplets assigned across system boundaries. Single-beam mask islands are rejected only with a larger stem-owning note and a straight beam without a rounded head bulge. Original synthetic regressions cover damaged and genuine key changes, adjacent systems, brackets, octave direction, staff-rule intersections and small chord heads. No model weights, private scores, manual meter annotations, device logs or external code included. Prior unrelated OmrScoreInterpreter drift remains visible; only reviewed hunks were ported. Guide cache invalidation is Android-only. These checks do not constitute complete source-note verification.

isolated_beam_probe_review.boundary: Resolve a conflicting extra beam only when two noteheads share a physical stem and endpoint, the longer trace reads one fewer beam, and adjacent pixel probes corroborate that lower count. Single-note readings and consistent chord beams retain their existing behavior. Six original generated regressions cover scan-fringe cores, a shared chord stem, a narrow supported beam and conservative single-note handling. Existing unrelated OmrScoreInterpreter drift remains reported. No model or private fixtures included.

isolated_tab_fret_review.boundary: Shared raster crops isolate printed frets from rules, barlines, labels, rhythm stems and dense screenshot controls. Cleaned and original OCR readings are reconciled within each crop; a long central enclosed counter corroborates open frets. Confirmed inline effects are retained. Dark and pale barline passes are combined, and unbarred opening/closing tab measures retain their notes. Android ML Kit remains an app adapter: it reads bounded glyph montages with synthetic numeric context, maps symbols back to original crops, and preserves partial results on timeouts. Standalone OCR providers may use TabFretRaster.crops, clean, openFret and reconcile before TablatureDecoder.withWords. The standalone package does not bundle an OCR engine. Synthetic tests only; no private scores, fret transcriptions, phone logs, or fonts are included. Model weights unchanged; printed fret correctness does not establish unwritten rhythm or graphical bend/slur performance.

native_tab_rhythm_review.boundary: Reviewed six/seven-string geometry, explicit tuning, native PDF token matching, detached rhythm, visible ties, muted-note tie termination, rests, grace frets, triplets, meter, tempo and H/P/T/vibrato marks. Original generated Java/PDF regressions only. Android PDF search and first-page OCR adapters remain app-specific; the standalone CLI uses optional pypdfium2 to provide equivalent normalized words and carry tuning. Guide cache invalidation and PDF lifecycle hooks are Android-only. No private scores, annotations, logs, history, new dependencies or changed model weights. Existing MeterChangeDetector, OmrScoreInterpreter and ScorePageTimeline drift remains visible and was not absorbed. Printed-symbol pitch and measure-duration checks do not establish full expressive playback: graphical bends, whammy and strum direction remain unsupported.

bounded_timing_review.boundary: Thread-confined bounded timing sessions reuse identical voice-clock and cross-staff candidate calculations; attack lists are cached within unchanged rhythm groups. Shared highlight preparation and standalone export use sessions. Synthetic equivalence, nested-session and repeated-read regressions included. Android asynchronous drawing, persisted optional audio note counts and import-only ambiguous bend-fraction metadata filtering remain app adapters. No mathematical timing rules, dependencies, weights, private scores, logs or library data included. Existing MeterChangeDetector, OmrScoreInterpreter and ScorePageTimeline drift remains visible.

regional_staff_continuity_review.boundary: Regional pitch recovery checks seven independent strips, fits the staff slope, and then requires four rules to remain continuous across the page. One line may be covered by notation; two interrupted lines cannot rephase a semantic staff. Original generated regressions only. No score image, device data, Android adapter, dependency or model weight is included. Existing unrelated mapped drift remains visible.
